thread:
alex_m: Heads-up — I'm scheduling a k6 night run to profile a suspected p95 regression on the inference path. Target window 00:30–02:00 UTC. Will exercise hosted + dedicated routing. TL;DR: need quick ✅ on config and canary hooks.
maya: ack. which test script and dataset? are we hitting the new quantized model or the fallback older one?
alex_m: test script is tests/k6/inference_profile_v2.js, ramp 0->2500 vus over 10m, steady 90m, thresholds p50/p95/p99. We'll hit both variants via header: X-Model: redwood-v2q and redwood-v2 (fallback). dataset is small-ish prompts/profiles (~5K unique prompts), seeded from s3://redwood-loadbench/prompt-sets/nightly-2026-03.
ben_r: suggest adding a KV-cache warmup stage. On previous runs cold KV spikes show up. Add 10m low-rps prefix warmup hitting long-context prompts
tj: do we want Locust-style user patterns (bursty) or steady k6 flat traffic? If hunting latency regressions, steady is better; bursts may mask p95
alex_m: agree steady. but include a 5m burst at minute 60 to validate autoscaler.
sarah_oncall: please add a smoke gate: if errors > 0.5% in the first 15m, abort. Also create an incident toggle to pause test if any region reports host OOM. I'll be on call for the window.
maya: can you share the k6 options snippet? I'll add CI job that posts results to the perf-runner dashboard.
ben_r: snippet:
```bash
K6_OPTS='--vus 2500 --duration 1h30m --rps 0 --out json=artifacts/k6-nightly-v2q.json'
export MODEL_HEADER='X-Model'
k6 run tests/k6/inference_profile_v2.js --env MODEL_HEADER=$MODEL_HEADER
```
Also include env var KV_WARMUP=true to toggle warmup stage in the script.
ci-bot: deploy-bot posted: "k6-job queued: inference-profile-v2 (owner: alex_m) scheduled at 2026-03-18T00:30:00Z"
alex_m: thanks — Ben can you add a small tracepoint in the runtime that logs fallback_count and kv_hit_rate to /metrics/trace? we want per-minute series in the dashboard.
ben_r: yes I'll drop a lightweight counter. nothing blocking
tj: reminder: set request header X-Test-Run: nightly-2026-03-18 so we can filter in logs.
maya: I'll wire up the dashboard and add the smoke-gate threshold. where should results land? perf-runner or shared S3?
alex_m: perf-runner for quick triage, S3 for archival. CI job will copy JSON to s3://redwood-loadbench/results/nightly-2026-03.
sarah_oncall: plan looks good. one ask: include a small canary subset (10% traffic) pinned to dedicated cluster to verify dedicated latency SLOs separately.
alex_m: added. final checklist:
• KV warmup enabled
• Header routing to both variants
• 10% canary to dedicated cluster
• Smoke gate 0.5% errors first 15m
• 5m burst at minute 60
• tracepoint for fallback_count + kv_hit_rate
• k6 JSON to perf-runner + s3
I'll kick it off after ben's tracepoint lands. thanks all :thumbsup:
ben_r: tracepoint PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/+/4567 — small change, tests passing.
ci-bot: deploy-bot posted: "k6-job started: inference-profile-v2 (run-id: run_20260318_0001)"
alex_m: run started. will post a short summary in ~2h with p95 diffs and flags for follow-ups.
maya: standing by to capture dashboard snapshots and alert if thresholds cross.
alex_m: update — at +30m p95 on v2q spiked to 520ms (baseline ~410ms). kv_hit_rate dropped ~12%.
ben_r: digging into logs; I see a cache warming thrash on a subset of shards, opening a live trace now.
tj: if we need extra load to reproduce, we can rerun with 4k vus but keep burst off.
alex_m: thanks everyone. I'll open a follow-up thread with postmortem if this escalates.
